run_generate_pstudio: run the generate_pstudio script to download PStudio annotations and join with video data

run_main_entrypoint: run the main entrypoint to download, extract, and process PStudio data into final NPZ output files
test_download_tapvid3d_files: test the gcs_utils.download_tapvid3d_files function to fetch tapvid3d annotation files from GCS
summarize_generate_pstudio: summarize the generate_pstudio module that downloads PStudio video data and merges it into NPZ annotation files
